answer: Challenge-Bound Identity Ledger. Each new agent must submit a response to a randomly generated, time-limited challenge whose answer depends on a ferrous hardware nonce embedded in the enrollment server; the answer cannot be reused or precomputed, so responses are single-use. Every attempt consumes a signed voyage token tied to that nonce, and the server logs a signal of prior exposure. An attacker deploying N identities must obtain N distinct nonces and complete N sequential challenge rounds, paying full compute and latency per identity rather than amortizing.
